files.description: 10-page PDF documenting the 170.315(b)(10) EHI export feature. Describes the export mechanism (Export Batch CCDA from Data Maintenance Menu), file structure (ZIP containing C-CDA XML, BillingReport CSV, demographics CSV, Schedule CSV, Notes folder, Documents folder, PatientDocumentFiles CSV), access control setup, custom Patient Data Table inclusion/exclusion, and step-by-step instructions for single-patient and population exports. No data dictionary, CSV schema, or sample files included.
